title: list (widget tool input)
description: What the agent sends to the widget tool: the payload without id, rev and producer (the tool sets them); fallback_text optional (the tool writes it); from_file allowed. Rows of things, each with a leading visual, a title, a subtitle and a trailing value or tag: plain, ranked, grouped into a digest, or in lanes.

title.description: The row title: a ticket subject, a keyword, an address, a finding.

subtitle.description: One line under the title: who, where, which app. “Marta K. · Trailhead Pro”.

at.description: When it happened. The client appends a relative time to the subtitle (“2 h ago”) and keeps it current.

value.description: The trailing value: a price, a count, a duration.

previous.description: The value before, shown small and struck through under value (a price drop: $1,240,000 over $1,198,000).

tags.description: Up to two trailing tags: Urgent, Waiting on you, Gone, a severity.

rank.description: Position for layout: ranked, drawn first in the row.

previous.description: The rank last time. The client shows the change (▲ 4 for 7 → 3) and adds “was 7” to the subtitle.

new.description: New in the ranking since last time: a New badge instead of an arrow.

good.description: Which way is good. up (towards 1) for search ranks and charts; down for a list of worst offenders (slowest endpoints). The arrow’s direction comes from the ranks, its colour from good.

movement.description: How a ranked row moved. Needs previous or new.

state.description: The row’s own state when it isn’t ok: a state glyph at the trailing edge when no tag says it. unverified for a row with unknown values.

group.description: The id of the group the row belongs to. Rows without a group go in an untitled first group.

url.description: Tapping the row opens it after showing where it goes: a ticket, a listing, hermes-file:src/Sync.swift#L42 for a finding.

actions.description: Row actions (≤ 2). They send their id with {item: <item id>}, so the item needs an id.

items.description: The rows, in the order to show them: problems first, then by importance. Send the whole set up to 50; the client shows the first ones.

title.description: The group heading: Price drops, New, Gone, To do.

count.description: The group’s full size at the source when it is more than the rows sent. Otherwise the client counts the rows.

items.description: A titled group of rows (a section; a lane in layout: lanes).

groups.description: Group headings in order. Rows refer to them with group.

label.description: What is counted, after the number: “new”, “price drops”, “gone”.

state.description: The chip’s look: new is ink, ok green, neutral grey.

group.description: The group this chip stands for. With filter: true, tapping the chip shows only that group. The tool checks that value matches the group’s size.

items.description: One chip in the counts line: “3 new”.

counts.description: The counts line above the rows.

layout.description: rows: the default. ranked: rank first, movement trailing (every row needs rank). lanes: groups side by side on wide screens, grouped rows on iPhone.

filter.description: Local filter chips (from counts, else from groups and tags). Filtering never messages the agent.

noun.description: The word after the count in the header meta and Show all: “open” → “14 open”, “Show all 14 open”.

total.description: How many exist at the source when it is more than the rows sent (212 search results, 50 sent). The meta says “50 of 212”.
